mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Percentage Volume Oscillator crossing above its signal identifies fresh participation acceleration; follow the completed four-hour price direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed four-hour close/open log return at a bullish PVO-signal crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: PVO divides the EMA(12)-EMA(26) base-volume spread by the positive slow volume EMA, then compares that scale-free participation rate with its EMA(9). It supplies no price direction itself and is distinct from price PPO, raw relative volume, ticket expansion, cumulative flow, PVT, OBV, OI, funding, fitted outcomes, reused event sets, and promoted controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour volume-acceleration ignition clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including finite nonnegative base volume with strict positive completed sum
features.fast_ema: causal EMA(12) of completed base volume using alpha=2/13, reset across gaps
features.slow_ema: causal EMA(26) of completed base volume using alpha=2/27 and required strictly positive
features.pvo: 100*(fast volume EMA-slow volume EMA)/slow volume EMA
features.signal: causal EMA(9) of PVO using alpha=2/10
features.event: current PVO-signal is strictly positive and immediately prior finite PVO-signal is <=0
features.terminal_return: log(completed four-hour close/open), finite strict nonzero
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical PVO(12,26,9) upward signal crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no periods, smoothing convention, scaling, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: EMA(12) of volume minus EMA(26), divided by EMA(26) and multiplied by 100; EMA(9) signal; strict upward line crossover
external_basis.selection_use: published defaults 12,26,9, percentage normalization, and upward signal crossover only; BTC direction and holding application are untested; no incidence or outcomes
